_comment: TEMPLATE - copy this file, rename it, and fill in the values from your test. Leave any setting null if unused. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level in volts (or "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage). The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. Enum values: trigger_source "CH1"/"CH2", trigger_slope "RISE"/"FALL", trigger_mode "NORMal"/"AUTO", input_coupling "DC"/"AC". measurement is metadata: "rms"/"delay"/"pulse_width".
